decision: Ten Second Stop and Go Penalty.
event_name: Date 18 April 2021 Time 15:51 2021 EMILIA ROMAGNA GRAND PRIX 15 - 18 April 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 47), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: All tyres were not fitted at the 5 minute signal.
offence: Breach of Article 36.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Ten Second Stop and Go Penalty.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the report from the Technical Delegate and video evidence. The rear wheels of car 5 were not fitted at the 5 minute mark as required by Art 36.4. The stewards applied the mandatory penalty.
rules_referenced: Article 36.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 5 All Tyres Not Fitted At 5 Minute Signal
